includeForeignRadarTreasures.falseWithoutExplicitViewerAllianceId:
(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(data_json,'$.treasureType') AS INTEGER),0)<>1
                      OR (COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(data_json,'$.allianceId') AS TEXT),'')<>''
                        AND CAST(json_extract(data_json,'$.allianceId') AS TEXT)=COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(data_json,'$.viewerAllianceId') AS TEXT),'')))
includeForeignRadarTreasures.meaning: non-radar rows pass; treasureType=1 radar rows are same-alliance only unless the caller opts to include foreign radar treasures

luckyFirst.stableContinuation: ordinary recovered sort followed by record_key ASC

claimStateCache.cleanup: DELETE FROM treasure_claim_states WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time>0 AND expire_time<=?1
claimStateCache.upsert: INSERT INTO treasure_claim_states(server_id,player_uid,treasure_uuid,expire_time,updated_at,state_json) ... ON CONFLICT(server_id,player_uid,treasure_uuid) DO UPDATE SET expire_time=excluded.expire_time,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,state_json=excluded.state_json
claimStateCache.pageJoin: LEFT JOIN treasure_claim_states AS state ON state.server_id=page.server_id AND state.player_uid=<viewer> AND state.treasure_uuid=page.uuid
claimStateCache.pageProjection: state.state_json is selected for Treasure pages
